title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction

  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses

  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.

  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Engenheiro de vendas
description:
Empresa: LoopGlobal
Local: Brasil (Atuação Nacional)
Modelo: Híbrido | Disponibilidade para viagens
Sobre a LoopGlobal
A LoopGlobal é um ecossistema industrial formado por quatro pilares estratégicos:
LoopZero – Engenharia, simulação de processos (MAGMASOFT), desenvolvimento de projetos e soluções avançadas para moldes e injeção.
LoopParts – Comercialização de máquinas e equipamentos para fundição de alumínio, injeção, automação e usinagem.
LoopService – Assistência técnica, start-up, manutenção e otimização de células de injeção.
LoopAcademy – Treinamentos técnicos e capacitação profissional para fundição e injeção de metais.
Nosso propósito é entregar soluções completas para o setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio, combinando tecnologia, engenharia, alta performance e atendimento de excelência.
---
Descrição da Vaga
Buscamos um Engenheiro de Vendas para atuar no setor de injeção de alumínio e automação industrial, com foco em prospectar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades comerciais junto a fundições, injetoras e empresas do segmento metalmecânico.
O profissional será responsável por identificar necessidades técnicas, propor soluções completas (máquinas, células, periféricos, automações, simulações e serviços) e conduzir as negociações até o fechamento.
---
Responsabilidades Principais
Atuação Comercial
Prospectar novos clientes no setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio.
Gerenciar carteira de clientes, mantendo relacionamento contínuo.
Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais de máquinas, células completas e soluções de automação.
Realizar apresentações técnicas e reuniões com tomadores de decisão.
Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margens e projeções comerciais.
Atuação Técnica
Compreender processos de injeção de alumínio (alta pressão).
Interpretar desenhos, projetos e necessidades de células de produção.
Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.
Interagir com engenharia interna (LoopZero) para validação técnica via MAGMASOFT.
Participar de start-ups, FATs e visitas técnicas quando necessário.
---
Requisitos
Formação
Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência
Vivência no setor de injeção de alumínio (HPDC) ou fundição.
Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)
Habilidades Técnicas
Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico.
Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.
Diferencial: Familiaridade com simulação MAGMASOFT.
Habilidades Comerciais
Comunicação consultiva.
Negociação e relacionamento.
Organização e gestão de pipeline.
Autonomia para visitas e viagens.
---
Benefícios
Remuneração fixa + variável agressiva por performance.
Suporte técnico completo da equipe LoopZero e LoopService.
Treinamentos pela LoopAcademy.
Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.
Crescimento estruturado dentro do ecossistema LoopGlobal.
---
Perfil Ideal
Buscamos alguém técnico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, que domine o ambiente de chão de fábrica e saiba transformar conhecimento técnico em soluções comerciais de alto valor agregado.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.

Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.

title: Global Training & Development Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re looking for a Training & Development leader who drives real impact. In this role, you’ll design and deliver learning programs that help employees excel in their roles, accelerate their careers, and develop the next generation of strong leaders. If you’re passionate about learning that transforms performance and strengthens organizational capability, this is the role for you.


Responsibilities


  • Own the full lifecycle of training and development programs, from needs assessment through delivery, to strengthen workforce capability, performance, and productivity.
  • Assess skill gaps and business needs to design targeted learning programs that overcome performance challenges and boost workforce effectiveness.
  • Develop and scale programs that accelerate internal mobility, strengthen functional talent pipelines, and build leadership readiness.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure learning initiatives align with department goals, driving both capability building and measurable business impact.
  • Create and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learning to ensure knowledge retention and consistent on-the-job application.
  • Track and continuously improve key metrics, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up, training completion and application rates, and talent readiness for future roles.


Requirements :


  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies; relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, delivering, and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to understand complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

description:
Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) — Epilepsy Study (Phase II/III)

If you’re someone who thrives in neurology studies and enjoys working on impactful research, this could be a great fit for you.

This sponsor truly values quality and consistency, and you’d be joining a talented team dedicated to advancing care for patients with seizure disorders.


The application window is short , so if this sounds like something you’d like to explore, let’s set up a quick chat today!

title: LATAM Business Development Representative
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results-focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Summary

Do you love the thrill of victory? Are you interested in a path to success? Then the Business Development Representative role at Prometheus Group is your job! Business Development Representatives immediately affect the overall pipeline and growth of our company. With the advanced sales tactics that we institute, you will not only be an integral part of our sales process but also contribute to our overall bottom line. The Business Development Representative role is the backbone of our successful LATAM sales team, and we want you to be a part of that!


At Prometheus Group, we live and breathe off a meritocracy-based promotion system. Promotions are not based on tenure but based on the ability & talent you possess within this role. Business Development Representatives will have opportunities to progress into different paths, such as Account Management or Team Management.


Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential clients, so ambition is a top priority when looking for the perfect candidate. You will use your communication skills to cultivate strong relationships with prospects from the first contact until you qualify the opportunity. Do you think you have what it takes? Submit your resume today!



Responsibilities

  • Maintain high call volume daily (80-100 calls)
  • Develop leads in cold and warm prospect accounts to generate interest in our solutions.
  • Gather prospects' needs and understand their initiatives related to our solutions.
  • Discover new software opportunities by calling targeted prospect accounts
  • Generate a steady flow of qualified opportunities each month
  • Develop and deliver high-level product presentations to new clients.
  • Participate in the development of accounts, prospect profiling, and sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with experienced account managers when prospecting accounts and creating opportunities.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese
  • High-energy self-starter who can learn quickly and engage clients
  • 1+ years of cold calling experience preferred
  • Ambition to grow and build a career in sales
  • Ability to resonate with the prospect's situation and detect needs
  • Positive and energetic phone skills
  • Customer-focused, results-driven with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Salesforce experience is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(Go e Java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel

Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.

Visão geral do cargo

Estamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou pleno para projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.

O que você fará

• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).

• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.

• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).

• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.

• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.

• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.

Requisitos mandatorios:

• Sólida experiência com Golang.

• Experiência com Java 8+.

• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).

• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).

• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.

• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.

Diferenciais

• Experiencia com framework quarkus.

• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).

• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.

• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: LATAM Business Development Representative
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results-focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Summary

Do you love the thrill of victory? Are you interested in a path to success? Then the Business Development Representative role at Prometheus Group is your job! Business Development Representatives immediately affect the overall pipeline and growth of our company. With the advanced sales tactics that we institute, you will not only be an integral part of our sales process but also contribute to our overall bottom line. The Business Development Representative role is the backbone of our successful LATAM sales team, and we want you to be a part of that!


At Prometheus Group, we live and breathe off a meritocracy-based promotion system. Promotions are not based on tenure but based on the ability & talent you possess within this role. Business Development Representatives will have opportunities to progress into different paths, such as Account Management or Team Management.


Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential clients, so ambition is a top priority when looking for the perfect candidate. You will use your communication skills to cultivate strong relationships with prospects from the first contact until you qualify the opportunity. Do you think you have what it takes? Submit your resume today!



Responsibilities

  • Maintain high call volume daily (80-100 calls)
  • Develop leads in cold and warm prospect accounts to generate interest in our solutions.
  • Gather prospects' needs and understand their initiatives related to our solutions.
  • Discover new software opportunities by calling targeted prospect accounts
  • Generate a steady flow of qualified opportunities each month
  • Develop and deliver high-level product presentations to new clients.
  • Participate in the development of accounts, prospect profiling, and sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with experienced account managers when prospecting accounts and creating opportunities.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese
  • High-energy self-starter who can learn quickly and engage clients
  • 1+ years of cold calling experience preferred
  • Ambition to grow and build a career in sales
  • Ability to resonate with the prospect's situation and detect needs
  • Positive and energetic phone skills
  • Customer-focused, results-driven with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Salesforce experience is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(Go e Java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel

Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.

Visão geral do cargo

Estamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou pleno para projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.

O que você fará

• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).

• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.

• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).

• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.

• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.

• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.

Requisitos mandatorios:

• Sólida experiência com Golang.

• Experiência com Java 8+.

Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem, mas muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

Estamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou pleno para projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. • Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) Pleno - Afirmativa PCD
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

description:

Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects



What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Java & React Sr (Home Office)
description:
A Insightful Consulting é uma empresa de tecnologia que transforma ideias em soluções digitais até 10x mais rápido com o poder do low-code Mendix da Siemens. Ajudamos empresas a acelerar sua jornada de inovação, unindo agilidade, escalabilidade e governança em um só ambiente.


Resumo da oportunidade

Atuação alocada em cliente do setor de Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e soluções que promovem relações mais éticas, sustentáveis e atentas a riscos e governança. Como pessoa desenvolvedora Java, você contribuirá na criação e evolução de aplicativos web e serviços, do desenho à implantação, em um ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.

O foco é construir software robusto com Java e Spring, integrar sistemas via APIs REST e aplicar boas práticas de engenharia, trabalhando em parceria com áreas de produto e, quando necessário, com clientes para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficazes.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos web multiusuário (back-end e front-end), com possibilidade de implantação em nuvem.
  • Conduzir atividades em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento e implantação, em metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais.
  • Participar da definição de soluções técnicas a partir de requisitos de negócio, colaborando com produto e clientes.
  • Escrever código bem projetado, testável, eficiente, confiável e seguro, aderente à arquitetura de referência.
  • Projetar e executar testes unitários e de integração.
  • Aplicar conceitos de reúso e zelar pela documentação do código.
  • Versionar e revisar mudanças continuamente, mantendo rastreabilidade.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Java (8/17 ou superior) e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data).
  • Experiência em front-end: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery e React.
  • Sólida experiência em APIs REST, autenticação com JWT e integração entre sistemas.
  • Experiência em Hibernate/JPA e bancos SQL (modelagem e otimização).
  • Experiência em AWS (serviços de nuvem), Docker (containers) e Git (versionamento).
  • Metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum.


Habilidades:

  • Projetar serviços e aplicações web escaláveis, observáveis e fáceis de manter.
  • Modelar dados e camadas de persistência com foco em desempenho e consistência.
  • Implementar integrações REST seguras e resilientes.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração, automatizando rotinas-chave.
  • Documentar soluções e apoiar revisões técnicas (code review).


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara com time, produto e stakeholders.
  • Colaboração e disponibilidade para discutir alternativas técnicas.
  • Organização e foco em qualidade de entrega.
  • Autonomia, responsabilidade pelo código e melhoria contínua.


Adicionais:

  • Graduação completa em TI (ex.: Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas).


Diferenciais (opcional):

  • Pós-graduação em áreas de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com NoSQL.
  • Experiência em projetos de integração usando OpenAI, Gemini e/ou Copilot.
  • Vivência com assistentes de programação baseadas em IA.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto .


Venha construir com a Insightful . Se esta oportunidade combina com você, candidate-se e vamos conversar!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development
